why: ‘Implement and validate a standalone Python module from scratch’ is a generic implementation-and-test workflow, but this task is an R statistical sampler and the card has no ARS content.
The task is an image-reading task and seg01 is the image-characterization card (all three attempts opened it), though it contains no chess piece-recognition procedure.
No card covers synthesizing a <32,000-gate boolean circuit from a simulator spec; bank/merge/0001 (candidate/evaluator) only weakly overlaps.
seg01's image-characterization steps and bank/merge/0000's OCR steps directly cover reading the code text out of /app/code.png.
0006's probe-install-configure-verify workflow directly covers installing and smoke-testing the git/ssh/nginx stack.
No card covers ICS parsing or calendar constraint solving; the path-tracing cards only characterize files whose format the prompt already defines.
0006 helps install/build 7z or john, but no card covers 7z2john/john password cracking.
0001's baseline/variant/evaluator loop matches constructing a distribution against the two KL metrics; bank/merge/0004 (final disk verification) is also applicable.
No card covers differential cryptanalysis of FEAL; path-tracing seg00 only concerns file characterization.
0003's data inventory/independent verification applies to pairs.txt/ciphertexts.txt and plaintexts.txt, but no card covers linear cryptanalysis.
0006's configure/make/smoke-test/repair workflow matches building this OCaml source tree, though the GC bug itself is not covered.
No card covers git reflog/object recovery or history cleanup.
No card covers sshd/git-server/nginx deployment hooks; bank/merge/0006 is about building software, not configuring services.
